Resolves #19442

🌿 A tour can no longer start from a layout that lists one pane in two windows.

Both Start buttons now enter through `Workspace#resetTopology()`, the same write "Reset to default" already makes, instead of assigning the shipped document to the main window alone. A pane torn into its own window comes home in that one undoable Group write. A refused reset starts no runner and stops the tour with the reset's errors.

Evidence: unit tier (a real `Workspace` bound to its Group, a real tear-out through `onTearOutDocumentChange`, the visible tour's entry), plus Euclid's browser witness of the defect before the fix ([6036429110](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19442#issuecomment-6036429110)) → a browser run of the repaired path is required for the Post-Merge item. Residual: that browser run, Residual-Owner: #14790.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.
